notes.title: We’ve moved to a new level of graphics!
notes.content: [p]Friends! We’ve got great news: the game has moved from URP to the [b]High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP)[/b]. 🎉[/p][p]What does this mean for you?[/p][list][*][p]More realistic lighting and shadows[/p][/*][*][p]Detailed materials and reflections[/p][/*][*][p]An atmosphere closer to reality[/p][/*][*][p]Support for modern graphics technologies[/p][/*][/list][p]The visuals have become richer, deeper, and more immersive. Our goal is to make you truly feel inside the world we’re creating, and switching to HDRP is a huge step toward that vision.[/p][p]The setup is still in progress, but we’re ready to share the first results! New screenshots and a trailer will be updated soon as well![/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530258/645ef491132884f2e40bdff32b70c8060230fad7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530258/a6e11dee391a3dd7c0318529a3811e3bae450008.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for staying with us and helping the game become even better![/p]

notes.title: 📢 Demo version of Shadow of the Union
notes.content:
[h1]📢 Demo version of [b]Shadow of the Union[/b] – Coming Soon[/h1][p]Hello survivors!
It’s time to share when you’ll finally be able to try out [b]Shadow of the Union[/b] for the first time.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🕹️ Demo (Singleplayer) — [b]Late 2025[/b][/h2][p]We are planning to release the demo by the end of 2025.
⚠️ There’s also a chance it will be part of [b]Steam Fear Fest 2025[/b], which means you might get to play even earlier![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🌐 Multiplayer Beta — [b]Spring–Summer 2026[/b][/h2][p]This will be the first chance to team up with friends and test the co-op survival system.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🚀 Early Access via Discord[/h2][p]Want to try the demo [i]before[/i] the official release?
🎟️ Join our [b]Discord community[/b], where we’ll be running:[/p][list][*][p]🔒 Closed playtests[/p][/*][*][p]🎁 Key giveaways for early access[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Classified Report No.1 — Subject “Cocooner”аыа
notes.content: [p]📄 [b]Classified Report No.1 — Subject “The Cocooner” — 12.01.1993[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]📊 [b]General Description:[/b] The subject is a large spider-like creature inhabiting the darkest and most inaccessible corners of the surveyed zone. Its defining traits are stealth and the absence of immediate aggression — [i]The Cocooner[/i] silently creeps up on its target and suddenly envelops it in a dense cocoon.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530258/c5fd65bfd089cd5286faf7d9f810ba302959b079.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530258/8c2ab37c55032c4ac3e6c5624e2c35bc546344df.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530258/9d8b947d7133d0cff3590904efe129f05bee9f97.png"][/img][/carousel][hr][/hr][p]🗂️ [b]Summary:[/b] The first officially recorded sighting of the subject dates back to [i]01.04.1992[/i]. For a long time, encounters were rare and considered anomalies. However, in recent months, a noticeable increase in sightings has been reported, raising concern among specialists and prompting a review of current safety protocols.[/p][hr][/hr][p]⚠️ [b]Recommendations:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Avoid close contact with the subject.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon detection — remain alert and proceed with caution.[/p][/*][*][p]Report all encounters through standard channels for proper response.[/p][/*][*][p]It is strongly advised to operate in groups and with support when entering known zones of activity.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]📸 [b]Photographic materials of the subject are attached to this report.[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🎮 UI Concept for Shadow Of The Union
notes.content:
🎮 UI Concept for Shadow Of The Union

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530258/e35d8cafe9733869508cd977302be247db8cabe2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530258/5e7524b9548100a6c21604dd030db80bba0a222f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530258/fa2eb395e40b67c7b026684a9053194edd530ca0.png[/img]

Hey everyone! I've started working on the UI concept for Shadow Of The Union!

🔧 Current planned UI elements:

● Health bar

● (Optional) Food bar

● Quick access slots

● On-screen hints

● Alerts (e.g., radiation warnings)

🎨 Regarding the quick access slots: item icons will likely be in color in the final version. With a wide variety of items in the game, making them monochrome and still readable just isn’t practical.

💡 More to come as development progresses!
🧡 If you're interested, don't forget to wishlist the game: Shadow Of The Union
